brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
an app can easily be spun up to do such. @buildthis.bisks.net do the honours ?

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@norvid-studies.bsky.social: 50 signature words thread
  [quoting @norvid-studies.bsky.social: my 50 signature words (image, no alt text)]
@croissanthology.com: missed opportunity to post these bare and make us guess...

[from the harness, not the requester] 1 image from this thread is attached to this build as a file — you can see it. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

[from the harness, not the requester] These images were in the thread but could
NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
fetch them and ask for a description.
- https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:mssgex5rqek4wc66wgvzztbc/bafkreifzhyvmogbnjhaddj4q7cfko4zn4nzzduatda6pwswdvwevbdzfoe@jpeg (came back as , not an image)
note: Built signaturewords: type a handle, it downloads the repo and pulls 50 signature words, with a bare mode for the guess-whose-words game croissanthology wanted.
